item.title: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank: the situation
item.description:
Israeli forces are demolishing homes of Palestinians accused of attacks in the West Bank while settler groups are attacking Palestinian olive harvesters, wounding three. In Gaza, Israeli attacks continue, killing at least four Palestinians and endangering children traveling to school. The UN rights office warns that displacement in Gaza is deepening into a nightmare and calls for an urgent UN protection force to be deployed to Palestine. Rare footage of Mohammed Deif and previously unseen videos of Hamas commanders killed by Israel have been released. The conflict has produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
